name: Render API
note: Use the Render REST API to inspect and manage Render services, workspaces, deploys, logs, metrics, workflows, custom domains, and related infrastructure; the environment variable RENDER_API_KEY is available. The API base URL is https://api.render.com/v1 and authentication uses the Authorization: Bearer $RENDER_API_KEY header. Verify the key with GET /v1/services?limit=3 using Accept: application/json and the Authorization header. Core read operations include listing workspaces via GET /v1/owners, listing services via GET /v1/services, retrieving service details, listing and retrieving deploys, and reading logs or metrics where supported; mutations such as deploys, environment changes, webhook configuration, and service settings require explicit approval. Example: curl --request GET --url 'https://api.render.com/v1/services?limit=3' --header 'Accept: application/json' --header 'Authorization: Bearer $RENDER_API_KEY'. Do not assume endpoint paths or fields; check the documentation first: https://render.com/docs/api and https://api-docs.render.com.
